title: Convert Insights to Marketing Intelligence
summary: Successfully converted the Insights feature to Marketing Intelligence. The transformation includes updating the frontend component (Insights.tsx) with marketing-focused UI text and suggestions, creating a new marketing analytics agent (marketing_analytics.py) with campaign analysis, competitor intelligence, trend detection, and recommendation capabilities, and establishing a comprehensive system prompt (marketing_analytics.md) for marketing intelligence analysis. Translation files were updated for both English and French locales to reflect the 'Marketing Intelligence' branding.
current_status: TASK-013 implementation completed. All acceptance criteria met: AI chat for marketing insights, campaign performance analysis framework, competitor intelligence structure, trend detection capabilities, and recommendation engine foundation are in place.
next_steps: Test the Marketing Intelligence UI updates in the frontend
Connect marketing_analytics.py agent to the frontend Insights component
Add campaign context loading from marketing data files
Implement analytics integration with actual marketing platforms
